options.label: Show Vehicle Settings Alerts
options.description: Shows an alert when you change a vehicle setting (TC, ABS, BB, Engine Map...).

options.label: Alert Size
options.description: Strip runs across the top. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Alert Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Show Pit Limiter
options.description: Shows speed and gear while the pit limiter is on.

options.label: Pit Limiter Size
options.description: Small covers the gear. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Pit Limiter Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Show Engine & Ignition Alerts
options.description: Shows IGN OFF and ENG OFF.

options.label: Engine Alert Size
options.description: Small covers the gear. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Engine Alert Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Show Launch Mode
options.description: Shows LAUNCH and the RPM at a race start, with the clutch in. Green while the RPM and throttle are in the window.

options.label: Launch Mode Size
options.description: Small covers the gear. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Launch Mode Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Clutch Above (%)
options.description: Clutch pressed more than this.

options.label: Speed Below
options.description: Standing still, or nearly. In SimHub's speed unit.

options.label: Green Window
options.description: Auto: on in F1, off in other sims. Set a car's own window on its Vehicle level.

options.label: RPM Window
options.description: Green between these revs...

options.label: Throttle Window (%)
options.description: ...and this much throttle.

options.label: Show Lift Now
options.description: Shows LIFT NOW for as long as Le Mans Ultimate's lift and coast cue is on.

options.label: Lift Now Size
options.description: Strip runs across the top. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Lift Now Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Lift Point
options.description: The cue counts up to 255. Lower shows LIFT NOW earlier (default 220).

options.label: Show Fuel Warnings
options.description: Warns when you're running out of fuel, by laps of fuel left.

options.label: Low Fuel Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Warning Levels (laps of fuel left)
options.description: Level 1 (right): the Fuel value blinks red. Level 2 (left): a LOW FUEL strip. 0 turns a level off.

options.label: Show Pit Now
options.description: A PIT NOW strip on the last part of the lap when about a lap of fuel is left (not in F1).

options.label: Show Engine Warnings
options.description: A red strip when the engine runs too hot or loses pressure.

options.label: Fuel Pressure
options.description: iRacing uses each car's own warning lights. LMU and rFactor 2 send engine overheating only.

options.label: Oil
options.description: Warns above these temperatures. 0 turns a limit off. Set a car's own limits on its Vehicle level.

options.label: Show Penalty
options.description: A red strip until you serve your penalty. ACC names the penalty; LMU and rFactor 2 only say how many are left. Clear Alerts hides it until the penalty changes.

options.label: Show Flags
options.description: A new flag pops up over the gear for 3 seconds, then stays as a thin bar across the top while it's out. Clear Alerts hides the bar until the flag changes.

options.label: Show Rotary Dials
options.description: Shows dial labels and an alert when you turn a dial (Ascher, Greywolf, Generic Control Mapper). Duration: Alert Duration (Vehicle Settings Alerts).

options.label: Rotary Dial Size
options.description: Strip runs across the top. Full Screen covers the dash.

options.label: Rotary Dial Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Show Damage Alert
options.description: Shows your damage when it gets worse.

options.label: Damage Alert Size
options.description: Strip runs across the top. Full Screen covers the dash. Block sits in the middle.

options.label: Alert Duration (ms)
options.description: In milliseconds (1000 = 1 second)

options.label: Damage Alert Duration (ms)
options.description: In milliseconds (1000 = 1 second)

options.label: Practice
options.description: Lap Review tab: the session buttons' checkboxes.

options.label: Lap Review Colors
options.description: Inverted uses a black background.

options.label: Lap Review Duration (ms)
options.description: In milliseconds (1000 = 1 second)
